B3-02.ko: 병 들고 튀긴 스파크 · 휘청 넘어짐
B3-02.atk: a small glass jar is shaken and a thin static zap snaps out with a quick high crackle, then a faint frizzy fizz like hair standing on end
B3-02.def: no shield, the jar clinks against a belt as the gnome stumbles back: a soft cloth thump, rattling glass, a tiny startled spark fizzing out

B3-03.atk: a length of loose copper wire is whipped out with a thin metallic swish, its bare tip touching the foe with a bright tick-tick zap and a short buzz
B3-03.def: a light flinch with no guard: a dull fabric thud, a coil of copper wire jangling softly, one weak spark pattering away

B3-04.ko: 털가죽 마찰 후 작은 번개 · 헛디딤
B3-04.atk: a quick rubbing of fur on amber, a dry crackling build-up, then a snapping little blue spark leaps across with a sharp electric crack and sizzle
B3-04.def: no guard at all, it hops aside awkwardly: scuffing boots, the faint dry rustle of fur, a stray static pop

B3-05.ko: 공책 든 학도의 스파크 · 책으로 막고 찌릿
B3-05.atk: a notebook is flung open and a flicker of electricity jumps from a pen nib: a paper flutter, a thin zippy crack, a light fizzing sting
B3-05.def: blocks weakly with a thick notebook held up: a papery thump, a small spark skittering across the cover, a frail glass inkwell clinking

B3-06.ko: 코일 짐 휘둘러 퍽 · 구리 코일에 퉁
B3-06.atk: a heavy copper coil is swung off the back like a club: a creaking strap, a low metallic whoosh, a dull bonk with a ringing hum of wire
B3-06.def: takes the blow on the coil strapped to its back: a deep copper bong, humming wire resonance, a few sparks trickling down the windings

B3-09.ko: 탐침 꽂아 땅 전류 쾅 · 바늘 떨며 피함
B3-09.atk: a metal probe is jabbed into the ground: a short clink, a trembling needle ticking fast, then a buried current erupts with a thudding crack and rumbling fizz
B3-09.def: scrambles back while a gauge needle ticks wildly: a light boot scuff, a small metal case rattling, a thin glancing zap off the probe

B3-10.ko: 피뢰침 닦던 천으로 번개 유도 · 피뢰침에 튕김
B3-10.atk: a polishing rag snaps and a brass rod is raised: a squeaky wipe, then a high bright bolt is drawn down with a sharp crack and ringing metal hiss
B3-10.def: raises the rod as a lightning catcher: a thin ringing ping, the hit drained to a sizzling hiss down the brass, a small flinching thump

B3-12.ko: 모은 전하 방전 퍽 · 장치로 살짝 막음
B3-12.atk: a capacitor knob is cranked: ticking clicks, a swelling whine, then everything releases in a sudden loud zap-crack with a burnt-wiring fizzle
B3-12.def: a small brass gadget catches part of the hit: a clanking tin knock, a short buzzing hum, a sputtering spark, a sooty hiss

B3-13.ko: 관측 장치로 약한 전류 흘림 · 기록판 퉁
B3-13.atk: a clipboard scribble and a clicking meter, then a steady medium current is pushed out with a rising hum and a rasping electric zzzt
B3-13.def: holds up a clipboard of metal plates: a flat tin clack, a dry crackle across the plate, a tired thump as the researcher sways

B3-14.ko: 번개 장전 포격 · 포신 방패로 받아냄
B3-14.atk: a short cannon is loaded with a glowing charge: a clacking breech, a rising whine, a hard flat boom of a lightning shell and a streaking crack to the target
B3-14.def: hunkers behind the stubby barrel: a deep iron clonk, ringing metal, loose sparks hissing off the muzzle, a gritty slide of boots

B3-15.ko: 전류 고리가 연달아 튐 · 사슬이 짤랑이며 흩어짐
B3-15.atk: links of crackling current whirl out in a chain: a jingling metallic spin, then three snapping blue arcs jump one after another with quick cracks
B3-15.def: chain links jangle up to deflect: a bright rattling clatter, sparks hopping from link to link and fading, a small glancing clang

B3-16.ko: 골렘 주먹에 방전 쾅 · 돌몸에 둔탁
B3-16.atk: a stone fist swings with a grinding creak, lands with a heavy thud, and a capacitor on its back dumps a cracking zap on impact
B3-16.def: a thick stone body takes it: a deep stony thud, gravel pattering, a brief hum from the mounted capacitor as sparks crawl over the surface

B3-18.atk: a wrench strikes a circuit box with a clank and a tick, then a sharp arc spits out with a rising whine and bright crackle
B3-18.def: a hinged brass plate flips up with a clack of gears: a tinny clang, whirring cogs, a short spark fizz, a boot skid

B3-20.ko: 설계도대로 시제 병기 발사 · 벽 장치 퉁
B3-20.atk: a blueprint rustles, a prototype device clicks and whirs, then a focused beam fires with a tearing zap and a crisp hissing burn
B3-20.def: a folding prototype shield pops open: a brassy click, a quick humming screen of sparks, a bright ricochet zing and a scrape

B3-22.ko: 수호기 번개 펀치 · 금속 몸으로 묵직히 받음
B3-22.atk: a heavy metal arm winds up with a servo whine, drops with a heavy clang, and a coil flares with a cracking electric discharge
B3-22.def: a steel body takes the blow: a deep clang that rings out, a humming ground-line, sparks sliding down its plating, immovable and solid

B3-23.ko: 강연 지휘봉으로 번개 유도 · 두꺼운 외투와 장치로 막음
B3-23.atk: a long wooden pointer taps a slate, then a slow crackle gathers and a booming bolt drops with a lecture-hall rumble and echoing crack
B3-23.def: wide-sleeved robe and a floating brass lens absorb it: a muffled thud, a deep hum of a shield, glass chiming once, a slow fading fizz

B3-24.ko: 섬광 장치 번쩍 · 고글 쓰고 흠칫
B3-24.atk: a flash lamp's shutter clicks, a rapid charging whine climbs, then a blinding burst pops with a hard crack and a ringing high whistle
B3-24.def: goggles clack down as it recoils: a thin glass tink, a flat bulb pop, a dull thump, fizzing filament and a stumbling shuffle

B3-25.ko: 땅 위 번개 측정 후 폭발 · 바늘 장치로 가볍게 막음
B3-25.atk: a seismic needle scratches, a deep rumbling vibration builds under the ground, and an upward arc crashes out with a sharp crack
B3-25.def: holds up a humming gauge-plate: a thin metallic ring, the rumble of ground vibration, a flicker of sparks, a brief clatter

B3-26.ko: 상처투성이 몸으로 번개 맞받기 · 감전에 익숙한 몸
B3-26.atk: a scarred hand points and an old stored bolt rips out: a slow rumble, a sudden wide crack and an echoing rolling thunder
B3-26.def: takes the lightning on its marked body with a dry crackle: a low thrum, hair frizzing, a tired groan, sparks sliding off harmlessly

B3-27.ko: 거대 축전기 방전 쾅 · 거대한 통이 울림
B3-27.atk: a vast capacitor bank groans, a deep rising whine swells, and the stored charge lets go with a ground-shaking boom and a rolling, roaring crackle
B3-27.def: its huge metal casing rings like a drum: a deep gong-like clang, a growing hum, plates vibrating and sparks flaring along the terminals

B3-29.ko: 천막 아래 여럿이 번개 모음 · 천막과 장치로 흩음
B3-29.atk: a tent flap snaps and several coils spit at once: overlapping crackles, a rising crowd of whines, then one ragged boom
B3-29.def: a canvas tent absorbs it with a heavy flap: rustling cloth, copper rods clinking, a spread of hissing sparks, many small thuds

B3-31.ko: 번개 울타리가 튕김 · 전기 장벽이 웅웅
B3-31.atk: a gate of electric fence lashes out: a thick humming buzz, a barrage of whipping arcs, a hard booming crack as the wall slams
B3-31.def: a standing curtain of electricity absorbs the blow: a deep resonant hum, crackling sizzle all along the wall, an enormous solid thump that does not give way

B3-32.ko: 푸른 거신 쿵쿵 걸어 번개 내리침 · 아다만트 몸에 우르릉
B3-32.atk: a giant adamant fist rises with a groaning of stone, then crashes down with a booming thunder crack and rolling rumble
B3-32.def: its vast blue crystalline body takes the strike: a very deep thud, a resonant ring of crystal, thunder rumbling in the chest, arcs crawling down

B3-33.ko: 학장의 지팡이 한 번에 번개 · 보호 구체가 윙
B3-33.atk: a heavy staff rings on stone, a swell of power rises, and a single enormous bolt cracks down with a bell-like ringing tail
B3-33.def: a rotating orb of copper rings flares: a smooth humming dome, a deep thunk against the barrier, glass chiming once, fading sparks

B3-34.ko: 기관 쉬는 소리 후 폭발 · 기관 덮개로 쾅
B3-34.atk: a slow steam-like exhale and ticking gears, then a sudden huge detonation of stored lightning, a heavy boom and shrapnel of sparks
B3-34.def: an armoured housing takes it with a thudding boom: gears grinding, a long metallic groan, vents hissing, sparks bouncing off the casing

B3-36.ko: 시제품 천둥 기관 포효 · 겹겹 합금판
B3-36.atk: a massive prototype engine whirs up its gears, then discharges a thunderclap that cracks wide with a clanging mechanical rumble
B3-36.def: thick riveted plates slam together: a clanging chorus of metal, a deep hum, sparks flying from rivets, a last grinding rattle of cogs

B3-41.ko: 고무와 사기로 번개 비켜냄 · 둔한 퉁
B3-41.atk: a rubber-gloved hand swings a small brass hammer: a dull rubbery thwack, a hollow knock on porcelain, a tiny annoyed spark
B3-41.def: rubber and porcelain plates turn the strike aside: a soft dense thump, a hollow porcelain ring, a harmless sizzling skid of sparks off the insulators

B3-42.ko: 접지 탑이 벼락 땅으로 흘림 · 반격 전기
B3-42.atk: a weak jab, a metal rod clacks, then a flick of leftover charge zaps outward with a short crisp crack
B3-42.def: a tall tower of copper channels the hit into the earth: a huge ringing clang, a long descending hum into the ground, then a sharp counter-shock cracking back

SP-B3.ko: 거신경 눈뜬 일곱 번째 · 신경이 울림
SP-B3.atk: a deep wake-up groan of machinery, a million-volt whine climbing, then a great swelling bolt tears out with a thunder boom, a thin chorus of crackling nerve-like arcs, and a bell-like ring of glass
SP-B3.def: its metal body drinks the hit and hums: an immense low thrum, a glass-like ring, arcs flowing outward in answer, a breath of deep rumble

UN-B3.ko: 빈 병에 번개 다시 고임 · 병 속 번개가 소용돌이
UN-B3.atk: a jar is unstopped and an ancient lightning spirit bursts out with a cork pop, a fierce howling whine and a snapping bolt, glass ringing
UN-B3.def: empty bottles on its belt catch the magic: tinkling glass, a swirling inner buzz, a flash refilling with crackle, a tiny bell-like ping

UN-B3-7.ko: 자기장으로 번개를 비틀어 쏨 · 자기장이 휘어짐
UN-B3-7.atk: a great field coil hums, a warping oscillating whine bends and a twisting bolt is flung with a sweeping curve and a heavy electromagnetic crack
UN-B3-7.def: a swirling magnetic field wobbles the hit: a deep warbling hum, metal creaking, the strike bent aside with a rising-falling whoosh and loose iron clinking

EP-B3-1.ko: 전하를 조금씩 흘려 쏨 · 방전 장치
EP-B3-1.atk: a spark gap tick-tick-ticks, steady little bolts fire off in a stuttering rhythm with a sharp zapping buzz and ozone hiss
EP-B3-1.def: a leaky capacitor jacket shunts the hit: a humming bleed-off, a rapid fizzing, glass tubes glowing and clinking, a small spark patter

EP-B3-2.atk: a stylus taps a diagram, then a bolt strikes, leaps, and leaps again: three rapid cracks, each higher, and a trailing rattle
EP-B3-2.def: a ring of copper links catches the strike and spits it onward: a sharp clang, sparks jumping, a rapid trio of fading zaps, a last clatter

EP-B3-3.atk: a walking tower stomps, rods lower with a groaning clank, and a ground-to-sky bolt fires with a cracking boom and thunder echo
EP-B3-3.def: its tall frame groans with a lattice of metal: a huge ringing clang, a rumbling hum, bolts racing up the rods and exploding in a distant boom

PN-B3-C1.ko: 코일이 붙든 전하 · 넘어져도 안 터짐
PN-B3-C1.atk: a small coil sparks as the assistant lunges: a steady humming drone, a rubbery snap, a mid-tone zap held without letting go
PN-B3-C1.def: stumbles but holds steady with the coil on its back: a firm clanking thump, a patient constant hum, a few flickers that do not release

PN-B3-C2.atk: a legged capacitor lurches with a clattering patter, a whine rises dangerously, then an overcharged burst slams with a bursting boom and a searing sizzle
PN-B3-C2.def: an overfull casing creaks and bulges: a metallic strain, popping rivets, dangerous hum, a heavy dull thud and a fizz of leaking charge

PN-B3-C3.atk: a gloved sword stroke clanks on glass-plated armour: a rubbery creak, a heavy glassy clang, a short dry crackle on the blade
PN-B3-C3.def: layers of rubber and glass absorb the blow: a thick muffled clunk, glassy chiming, a short sizzle fading to dead stillness, planted and immovable

PN-B3-U1.ko: 피뢰탑 위에서 번개에 익숙 · 덜 아픔
PN-B3-U1.atk: a spanner clangs on a rod and a trickle of current jumps with a ticking zap and a scrappy buzz, repeated casually
PN-B3-U1.def: a rod above shrugs off the hit: a bright ping, a dull familiar zap, a grumbly groan, a hard-hat bonk, loose washers rattling

PN-B3-U2.ko: 말뚝 꽂자 번개 떨어짐 · 측량 장비
PN-B3-U2.atk: a surveyor's stake is hammered in with a thunk, a tripod clicks, then a heavy bolt crashes from the sky onto the spot with a crack and thunder
PN-B3-U2.def: a tripod and chain absorb the hit: a clanking of metal rods, a twanging measuring tape, an arc flickering down the stake with a hiss

PN-B3-R.ko: 병 속 번개 깨짐 · 병이 쨍그랑
PN-B3-R.atk: a bottle shatters against the foe: glass smash, a trapped bolt exploding free with a bright crack and a long tinkling fizz
PN-B3-R.def: bottles clink on a bandolier and one bursts: a glassy crash, a puff of sparks, tinkling shards, a quick refill of crackle in the others

PN-B3-E.ko: 신경 줄을 타고 번개가 번짐 · 줄줄이 떨림
PN-B3-E.atk: a taut nerve-like cable twangs, then a lightning surge races down it and chain-jumps with swelling whines and several overlapping cracks
PN-B3-E.def: hanging cables shake and thrum: a taut humming twang, a ripple of vibration along a row of devices, flowing arcs and a deep thrum

UP-B3-12.ko: 세 번 터진 실험 · 안정된 방전
UP-B3-12.atk: a precision-tuned capacitor bank clicks, its whine steady and fierce, then a thick brilliant bolt cracks in a boom with a tight hissing finish
UP-B3-12.def: a chest-high field emitter flares: a smooth humming dome, a hard crack against it, sparks sliding smoothly off, glass tubes ringing

UP-B3-18.atk: tools click and gears spin, a heavy hammer-like press slams and a combined arc and steam-hiss fires with a booming crack
UP-B3-18.def: interlocked brass plates and a rotating gear shield: a heavy grinding clank, a ringing ping, sparks spraying as gears mesh, a stable thud

UP-B3-22.ko: 수호기 셋의 코일 · 번개가 먼저 맞음
UP-B3-22.atk: triple coils flare as a giant steel fist slams: a servo roar, a massive clang, a crack of lightning thundering out
UP-B3-22.def: before the blow lands a field of lightning intercepts it: a roaring arc screen, a huge hollow metallic gong, sparks raining off the plating

UP-B3-23.atk: a long lecture bell rings once, a slow crackling orbit gathers and a vast bolt drops with a commanding boom
UP-B3-23.def: a mantle of floating brass rings spins up: a smooth resonant hum, a deep bell-like toll, glass ringing, the blow dissolving into a calm fizz

UP-PN-B3-C2.atk: a harnessed capacitor snaps its leash, discharges with a controlled thick crack and a clean low boom without chaos
UP-PN-B3-C2.def: a governor valve hisses as the casing absorbs and bleeds charge: a solid thud, a regulated hum, a clean gentle release of crackle

MB-03.cast: a sealed jar's cork pops, trapped current rushes out with a rising howl and then three snapping zaps hit one after another with a fizzing sting

SB3-01.cast: fur is rubbed on amber with a dry rasp, then three tiny sharp static snaps ripple down a line with quick fizzing pops and a thin buzz

SB3-02.cast: a brass rod is raised, a thunder crack from the sky is caught with a bright ping and drained into the earth with a long descending hum, twice

SB3-03.cast: wire winding and a ratcheting spool, a rising humming whine swells, then two crisp spark pops seal the energy into the targets

MB-07.cast: safety clips clack open, current races whining along wires, a swelling buzz rises and a row of circuits pops with a smoky sizzle and a bright spark chain

MC-08.cast: a single bolt strikes and spreads in rippling waves: a ringing arc, a shimmering oscillating hum, then armour layers fall off with rattling metallic pops and fizzes

SB3-04.cast: a curtain of electric threads drops with a soft rushing hiss and a humming screen, then buzzing sparks sweep across the line in two crackling waves

MB-11.cast: a clicking range-finder and ticking calculation, a rising whine, then one thunderous bolt drops exactly with a deafening crack and a scorching miss-zap beside it

SB3-05.cast: capacitors thump into a row, a shimmering electric wall rises with a swelling hum, then a bite of crackling spark snaps at the enemy front

SB3-06.cast: a clockwork device whirs on, a dark rumbling cloud rolls in with a growing rush, then a fine rain of forking zaps crackles down on everything

SB3-09.cast: a vast wind and thunder roll in, then overlapping bolts rain across the field in two heavy waves of crackling cracks and rumbling booms

RB3-1.cast: a deep groaning rumble from the earth, a colossal swelling whine, then a blinding white release cracks in three huge pulses, shaking everything with scorching echoing blasts

NB3-1.cast: one thick bolt pierces the first target with a heavy crack, then jumps with a weaker high snap to the next, trailing a rattling fizz

NB3-2.cast: a coin is flipped and spins with a bright ringing whir, lands with a rigged clink, and a quiet click of gears and a sly spark glow follow

HB3-1.cast: a faint static prickle, a quick shuffling of cards, a soft ticking calculation and one sly flick of a card sliding away into a deck

US-B3-1.cast: a rack of glass bottles shatters in a rapid cascade, bolts ricochet randomly with six cracking zaps, each from a different direction, chaos of sizzling and tinkling

US-B3-2.cast: a deep tremor in the ground, a long wire-like nerve twangs, then bolts erupt upward one after another in a descending rhythm of four heavy cracks and a rolling rumble

PS-B3-1.cast: a plug jammed in backwards, a sputtering reversed whine, a winding-down rewind sound, then a clunk as power is routed to a different place with a fizzing swirl

PS-B3-2.cast: two clamps clack onto terminals, a rising whine splits into two tones that cross over, then a heavy switch clunk and a single bright pop

RS-B3-1.cast: three glass jars are linked with a clink, a rolling hum passes through each, and a bright line of three equal cracks zaps down the row

RS-B3-2.cast: a hidden copper wire mesh twangs underfoot, a snapping buzzing net of sparks closes in, and a clatter of weapons dropping from numb hands follows

RS-B3-3.cast: a needle thumps against its stop with a ping, a bright full hum clicks into place, and a precise punchy double zap strikes the front

CS-B3.cast: a thin copper wire slaps across two contacts, a sharp spitting flash, then a spell's whine dies with a falling sputter, a pop and a puff of smoke

IB3-1.equip: a coiled copper wire is wound around a wrist with a springy twang, a clasp clicks, and a thin faint electric hum starts up

IB3-2.equip: a thick glove is pulled on with a leather creak, snaps shut with a buckle, and a knuckle switch clicks as a spark flickers and hums unreliably

IB3-3.equip: a staff with a brass needle tip is planted with a knock, a ratchet locks it in, and the tip lets out a stuttering tick-tick of sparks

IB3-4.equip: a glass jar is corked with a squeak and a pop, it clinks in a holder, a restless crackle buzzes inside as it is swung once

IB3-5.equip: a heavy tome is dropped open with a leathery thump, pages flutter, a brass clasp snaps, and a dry whisper-quiet crackle hums over the page

C4-1.equip: a glass orb is seated in a brass cradle with a ringing clink, gears tick as an inner light swells, and a layered resonant hum rises

IB3-7.equip: a crystalline detonator is jammed in with a crunch, a plunger clicks, and a hair-raising crystalline buzz starts to jump and pulse

IR-B3.equip: a cut rod of copper is hefted with a ringing clang, locks in a bracket with a snap, and a high, sharp spark whistles from its tip

PI-B3.equip: an ancient stoppered bottle is gripped with a hard crackling clasp, a storm spirit's howl swells inside, glass trembles, and lightning arcs painfully along the grip with a sizzle
